title: Southern Mayhem Fishing Charters LLC

services.name: Offshore Fishing
services.desc: Our offshore fishing trips make for an action packed day fishing the waters offshore of Port Canaveral. We target a wide variety of species including Pelagics such as King Mackerel, Mahi, Blackfin Tuna, and Wahoo. We also go after a variety of bottom fish such as Groupers, Snappers, and Amberjacks. Come test your luck and skill and see what the Atlantic Ocean has to offer. Scroll down for more information and to book your trip! If you are looking for a chance to get offshore but are unable to dedicate your entire day this is the trip for you! During this trip we primarily will focus on fishing reefs and wrecks 15-20 miles offshore target species such as king mackerel, cobia, mahi, blackfin

blurb: Southern Mayhem Fishing Charters is a local fishing guide service based out of Cocoa Beach and Port Canaveral Florida. We offer a wide range of fishing trips in the Space Coast area targeting all species from snook, tarpon, and redfish, all the way to grouper, snapper, mahi, and so much more! Our excellent charter services focus on the world class inshore and offshore fisheries that the Space Coast has to offer.
